newsitem.headline: Maytag Corp Q4 net up.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Q4 1995 includes $5,993,000 loss on business dispositions and $18,000,000 loss on guarantee of indebtedness. Excluding $0.10 a share guarantee loss and $0.03 business disposition loss, Q4 1995 operating earnings $0.29.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Full-year 1996 results include $40,000,000 restructuring charge and $1,548,000 loss on early retirement of debt. Excluding $0.24 a share restructuring charge and $0.02 a share loss on early retirement of debt, full-year 1996 operating earnings were $1.60 a share.

Full-year 1995 results include $146,785,000 loss on business dispositions, $16,500,000 cost for settlement of lawsuit, $18,000,000 loss on guarantee of indebtedness and $5,480,000 extraordinary loss on early retirement of debt. Excluding $1.30 a share business disposition loss, $0.05 early retirement loss, $0.09 lawsuit settlement expense and $0.10 loan guarantee loss, full-year 1995 operating earnings were profit of $1.35 a share.
